# Plan table fixtures

These are copies of the Lanes tables from `o-json-tutorials.md` (standard
Estimate header), `o-json-jobs-keys.md` (Est. and an extended Tests and
stories header), and `inbox-and-signals.md` (Lane time).

Only the tables are copied. Each has a generic example title. Personal
workspace path prefixes are replaced with portable `projects/` and
`workspace/` examples. Table text, Markdown, estimate ranges and structure
are retained. The golden JSON records the mapped specs; it intentionally
keeps dependency cells as free text rather than guessing dependency IDs.
